raw_record.question_text:
The following figure is a schematic diagram of the relationship between January and July temperatures and annual precipitation of a certain mountain area and altitude.

<image1>

According to the figure, what are the temperature characteristics at 1000m?
raw_record.standard_answer: Warm in winter and hot in summer

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram as a relationship chart with altitude on the vertical axis and temperature curves on the left. Locate 1000 m, i.e. 1 km, on the vertical axis, draw a horizontal mental line to the January and July temperature curves, and read their approximate temperature ranges from the left temperature scale. The January value is still above freezing and relatively high, while the July value is high, roughly in the hot-summer range. Therefore the temperature feature at 1000 m is 冬暖夏热.
